lines:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant User
    participant UI as UI Mockup Workspace
    participant Runtime as UI Mockup Runtime
    participant Store as UI Mockup Store
    participant Codex
    participant API as UI Mockup Revision Context API
    participant Save as Transactional Design Save API

    User->>UI: Edit layered SVG and draw annotations
    UI->>Runtime: Save working SVG, edit log, and vector annotation paths
    Runtime->>Store: Persist recoverable working draft
    User->>UI: Request AI revision
    UI->>Runtime: Mark draft pendingAgent
    Runtime->>Runtime: Render combined PNG from working SVG and annotations
    Codex->>API: list pending mockup revisions
    API->>Store: Read pending artifact metadata
    Codex->>API: get revision context
    API->>Runtime: Request deterministic preview
    API->>Store: Read accepted SVG, working SVG, manifest, edit log, and annotations
    API-->>Codex: Return structured context plus PNG image content
    Note over API,Codex: MCP exposes facts and does not interpret user intent
    Codex->>Codex: Interpret visual and structured changes against formal design
    Codex->>Save: Propose cleaned SVG and updated lightweight manifest with expected revision
    Save->>Store: Validate sanitization, stable ids, attachment, and base revision
    Store-->>UI: Project revision exposes proposed candidate
    User->>UI: Compare working and proposed versions
    alt user accepts
        UI->>Runtime: Accept proposal
        Runtime->>Store: Promote proposal to accepted SVG and clear draft evidence
    else user rejects
        UI->>Runtime: Reject proposal
        Runtime->>Store: Preserve working draft, edit log, and annotations
    end
